title: Must / Mustn't / Can't
summary: Use must for strong obligation and mustn't/can't for prohibition.

explanation.en: Must expresses a strong rule or obligation. Mustn't and can't can mean that something is not allowed.
explanation.ru: Must выражает строгую обязанность или правило. Mustn't и can't могут означать запрет.

examples.en: You must wear a seat belt.

commonMistakes.note: Use the base verb without to.

commonMistakes.wrong: You mustn't come early if you don't want to.
commonMistakes.right: You don't have to come early if you don't want to.
commonMistakes.note: Mustn't means prohibited; don't have to means not necessary.
